name: v20_gap_acceptance_ind
hypothesis: An overnight gap that is accepted by same-day intraday direction may contain persistent auction information.
notes: Simple QuantaAlpha-inspired gap acceptance test; distinct from pure close/open reversal.

name: v20_gap_rejection_ind
hypothesis: If gap acceptance is crowded or overreactive, the reversed sign may capture rejected overnight information.
notes: Controlled sign pair against v20_gap_acceptance_ind; submit only the stronger, lower-correlation version.

name: v20_gap_range_continuation_ind
hypothesis: Overnight gap scaled by recent intraday range may encode auction information beyond raw close/open reversal.
notes: Continuation sign for normalized overnight gap.

name: v20_gap_range_reversal_ind
hypothesis: Extreme overnight gap relative to recent range may mean-revert after auction overreaction.
notes: Reversal sign for normalized overnight gap.

name: v20_price_volume_coordination_ind
hypothesis: Correlation between price changes and volume changes, confirmed by intraday return direction, may proxy coordinated participation.
expression: rank(ts_corr(ts_delta(close, 1) / close, ts_delta(volume, 1) / volume, 20) * ts_mean((close - open) / close, 5))
notes: QuantaAlpha institutional-momentum proxy; watch turnover and self-correlation with close/open actives.

name: v20_range_deviation_reversal_ind
hypothesis: High recent intraday range relative to price may represent noisy overreaction and reverse.
notes: Range structure test; do not submit if it is just low-volatility exposure with weak sub-universe Sharpe.

name: v20_clean_trend_liquidity_ind
hypothesis: Short-horizon trend can be more reliable when realized volatility is low and relative volume participation is improving.

name: v20_returns_volume_reversal_ind
hypothesis: Recent returns on unusual volume can mark crowded short-term moves that reverse after smoothing.
notes: QuantGPT-inspired technical branch with high decay to control turnover.

name: v20_trade_when_volume_reversal_ind
hypothesis: Only trade short-term reversal when volume is above its 20-day average, reducing noise from quiet days.
notes: Tests trade_when syntax and conditional turnover control.

name: v20_debt_price_dislocation_ind
hypothesis: Price dislocation can be more reliable in safer balance-sheet names; low debt-to-enterprise-value avoids pure reversal exposure.
notes: QuantGPT debt/price branch, but with economically safer sign on debt.
